level_scale_note: every month's day and night grid scaled by 0.99 after the chain, which takes the signed mean difference over the measured index's conditions from +0.77 to +0.02 levels and its mean absolute difference from 1.42 to 1.35: the build was fitted on 140 conditions of which 121 are renders alone and 19 hold a recording as well, and the two kinds of reference differ by about a level (this build reads +1.20 against the recordings and +0.20 against the lossless renders of the same 18 moments), so the level is a compromise between them
